name: demo_card
title: Handing over a card
summary: The robot hands a card to the person and closes the laptop, turns to the side cart where a white mug stands, picks it up, turns back and puts it down on the desk.
robot: silver robotic arm with a black dexterous hand
setting: office desk with a laptop, organizer tray, and a white side cart

source.original_prompt: pick up card and give it to the person

segments.instruction: Extend the card forward until the person grasps it, keeping the camera pointed at the person and laptop.
Release the card as the person takes it, and retract the hand back over the wooden organizer.
Reach toward the laptop display and push it down until the lid is completely closed.
segments.memory_event: hide: laptop screen and keyboard hidden beneath the closed lid

segments.instruction: Turn the camera left toward the white side cart, where a white mug stands next to the white adapter on its top surface, and reach toward the mug.
segments.memory_event: hide: the main desk, organizer, laptop and person leave the view as the camera turns away

segments.instruction: Grasp the white mug standing on top of the side cart next to the white adapter by its handle and lift it a little, keeping the camera on the cart.
Turn the camera back to the main desk, holding the white mug.
segments.memory_event: return: the main desk reappears with the wooden organizer, the closed laptop and the person exactly as left

segments.instruction: Put the white mug down on the desk in front of the person, next to the closed laptop.
Let go of the white mug and pull the hand back beside the wooden organizer.
